scenario:
A financial services company is developing an enterprise-level Stock Market Trading Data Analysis System. The platform is designed to manage, analyze, and report on extensive stock trading data from various exchanges. This system will handle daily trading data for multiple stocks, including prices, volumes, turnovers, and trade statistics. 

The system provides advanced analytics capabilities to enable investors, analysts, and traders to make data-driven decisions. It supports the tracking of stock performance over time, the calculation of financial indicators, and the generation of market reports. The platform must manage large volumes of data efficiently, offering real-time data processing and historical data analysis.

Additionally, the system includes a user management module to ensure secure access, with different roles such as analysts, portfolio managers, and administrators. It supports customization of dashboards and reports to meet the specific needs of different users. The platform must also integrate with external market data providers and support data export in various formats for further analysis.
